item.title: Automatically Playing Piano in VRChat (Chinese Bar)
item.description: Introduction Recently, a friend told me that the piano in VRChat can play automatically. So I learned how to do it and wrote this article to document the process. Note: It seems to only work in PC mode. Of course, you can also try casting your desktop in VR (doge). Without Using MIDI Files 1.
